sections.Profile:
"Schuss" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in July 1968. Designed for a single player, it features four flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, four standup targets, and eleven star rollovers.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Sports, Original Theme, Skiing, Winter
